Body.Content:
Sales and account teams can now see whether delivery capacity is available while they build project quote estimates. They can spot staffing shortfalls before the deal closes, which helps them make delivery commitments they can meet, avoid staffing conflicts after the award and line up sales with delivery earlier.

Feature details

Availability inside the estimate: See remaining capacity for each labor estimate line's role and resourcing unit without leaving the estimate. You don't need to open the resource scheduling screens.

Time-phased view: Compare required hours with available hours by week or month. A shortfall in one period isn't hidden by surplus capacity in another.

Coverage at a glance: See whether available capacity provides full coverage, partial coverage or no matching capacity, along with the shortfall in hours.

Single-resource and total capacity: See whether one person can cover the entire effort, separately from the total capacity of the role in the resourcing unit.

Named resource details: Authorized users can view which eligible resources are available. Administrators control this with a setting, and existing security permissions still apply.

Based on bookings: Availability uses resource calendars, approved time off and hard bookings. Soft and proposed bookings are shown separately.

Availability is shown for information only. It doesn't reserve resources, create bookings or guarantee staffing.

GA date: September CY2027

Preview date: March CY2027
